answer: Bind every identity to a hardware quote from a basalt-hard TEE root: one device vouches for max 3 identities, quotes refresh every 14 days, each posts a 500 POA slashable bond. A forger buying one TEE machine per clone spends ~$400 to chase at most $12 of rewards, so 100 clones cost $40,000 for $1,200 - a losing trade. Each quote follows a strict 14-field sonnet schema; malformed fields are rejected, and revoked devices carry a violet marker. Edge case: rented cloud TEEs let one attacker spin many quotes; cap cloud quotes at 1 identity per device and demand re-attestation within 6 hours.
